    What we're looking for

    Can you make a clever move, predict a response and choose when to take a risk? Does another game feel irresistible? We want real human reactions, not just high bot scores.

    Print 48 cards using the link above. The up/down arrow governs the next card: ↑ means equal or higher, ↓ means equal or lower. A matching rank clears the pile.

    Prototype notice: These two mechanics are deliberately isolated. Balance, originality and retail appeal have not been proven.
